scene.label: Act 3, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Another part of the forest

lines.text: I am very cold, and all the stars are out too,
lines.plainText: I am very cold and all the stars are out too

lines.text: The little stars and all, that look like aglets.
lines.plainText: The little stars and all that look like aglets

lines.text: The sun has seen my folly. Palamon!
lines.plainText: The sun has seen my folly Palamon

lines.text: Alas, no; he's in heaven. Where am I now?
lines.plainText: Alas no he's in heaven Where am I now

lines.text: Yonder's the sea, and there's a ship; how 't tumbles!
lines.plainText: Yonder's the sea and there's a ship how 't tumbles

lines.text: And there's a rock lies watching under water;
lines.plainText: And there's a rock lies watching under water

lines.text: Now, now, it beats upon it; now, now, now,
lines.plainText: Now now it beats upon it now now now

lines.text: There's a leak sprung, a sound one! How they cry!
lines.plainText: There's a leak sprung a sound one How they cry

lines.text: Run her before the wind, you'll lose all else.
lines.plainText: Run her before the wind you'll lose all else

lines.text: Up with a course or two, and tack about, boys!
lines.plainText: Up with a course or two and tack about boys

lines.text: Good night, good night; you're gone. I am very hungry.
lines.plainText: Good night good night you're gone I am very hungry

lines.text: Would I could find a fine frog; he would tell me
lines.plainText: Would I could find a fine frog he would tell me

lines.text: News from all parts o' th' world; then would I make
lines.plainText: News from all parts o' th' world then would I make

lines.text: A carrack of a cockle shell, and sail
lines.plainText: A carrack of a cockle shell and sail

lines.text: By east and north-east to the king of pygmies,
lines.plainText: By east and northeast to the king of pygmies

lines.text: For he tells fortunes rarely. Now my father,
lines.plainText: For he tells fortunes rarely Now my father

lines.text: Twenty to one, is trussed up in a trice
lines.plainText: Twenty to one is trussed up in a trice

lines.text: Tomorrow morning. I'll say never a word.
lines.plainText: Tomorrow morning I'll say never a word
